caption: What does a real week of second-year medicine in Bulgaria look like? Last semester my main finals were Anatomy, Biochemistry and Physiology, with other modules spread through the week. Tuesday to Thursday were long; the other days were shorter. Each module has one or two colloquium midterms per semester, and Bulgarian language class is part of every week.
